definition: NiuTrans is a machine translation system.
details: It has a platform, an API, and two open-source translation systems. It is developed by the Natural Language Processing Group at Northeastern University (China).

explainer.lead: NiuTrans is a machine translation system offered as a platform, an API and two open-source translation systems. It matters as an accessible toolkit spanning hosted and open-source translation.

tiers.eli5: It's a translation tool you can use online, plug into other software, or download and run yourself.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers can integrate translation through the API or work with the open-source systems directly. A pitfall is that the platform and the open-source systems are separate offerings, so capabilities differ by route.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition or formula is given; it is a system comprising a platform, an API and two open-source translation systems.

explainer.example: A developer wanting self-hosted translation could adopt one of the two open-source systems rather than calling the API.
